title: Which Credits are Struck at Suspension
content:
The credits standing on the premium account of one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders are struck into the arrears figure according to the rider's standing.

## The rule

1. Where the rider stands ended, no credit is struck at all.
2. Where the rider stands at active and the rider record carries no day it ended, the credits posted within the days of grace that govern are struck.
3. Otherwise, every credit posted to the rider premium account is struck.

## Condition and credits struck

| The rider's standing | The credits struck |
|---|---|
| Ended | None at all |
| Active, the record carrying no day it ended | Those posted within the days of grace that govern |
| Any other standing | Every credit on the account |

## Worked on hypothetical inputs

A rider premium account carries credits of 12.00 USD and 8.00 USD, the first posted four calendar months before the month of handling and the second in the month of handling, the days of grace that govern giving a span of 2 whole months.

- **Ended:** no credit is struck at all, and neither the 12.00 USD nor the 8.00 USD enters the figure.
- **Active, with no day it ended:** only the 8.00 USD posted within the span is struck.
- **Suspended already, or in its waiting period:** both are struck, 20.00 USD.

## Note

Where the rider stands ended, the first case governs whatever the span would otherwise have admitted; the span does not come into that case at all.
